categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies ci/test/03_test_script.sh to change how CI executes and reports the IWYU check.
categories.rationale: Prevents the IWYU CI job from silently passing when compiler errors occur during analysis. Per the description, suppressed errors previously allowed CI to pass while omitting files from header analysis; making CI fail loudly fixes a misleading check.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and configures linter/static analysis enforcement in CI.
categories.rationale: Improves linter signal by ensuring compiler failures during IWYU analysis cause test failure rather than being masked. As noted in issue #35361, suppressed failures hid analysis errors from developers.
